title: sabulina tenuifolia subsp. hybrida
intro: Sabulina tenuifolia subsp. hybrida, commonly known as Sandwort, is a type of flowering plant in the carnation family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sabulina tenuifolia subsp. hybrida include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
